Case ID: 1052
Case Type: Refund
Date: 2025-03-12
Handled By: Customer Support - Lena Ortiz
Customer or Requestor: Marta Ellis
Title: Duplicate subscription charge after plan migration

Issue Description
Customer reported being charged twice after moving from a monthly plan to a quarterly subscription during a promotional weekend.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed payment history in the order platform and confirmed two successful captures within the same billing window.
- Checked promotion logs and found the original subscription was not fully canceled before the upgrade order processed.
- Verified there was no related chargeback or previous concession on the account.
- Coordinated with Billing Operations to confirm the extra charge would not recur in the next cycle.

Resolution
Issued a full refund for the duplicate monthly charge, added a note to preserve the quarterly plan, and sent the customer a written confirmation with a three-to-five business day bank posting window.

Follow-Up
Billing engineering opened a defect ticket to prevent duplicate billing during subscription plan transitions.

Reference Documents
- Refund Playbook v2
- Customer Operations SOP Library
